name: Exp_ColorJ2JMAStDev
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator, which combines a J2JMA smoothing filter with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes to size positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorJ2JMAStDev的信号进行交易，该指标结合了J2JMA平滑滤波器和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点位、直接、无信号）用于入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理以多种保证金模式确定仓位大小。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorJ2JMAStDev指标，该指标是J2JMA双平滑移动平均线与标准差通道的组合。入场条件分为三种模式：点位模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区中的信号点（非EMPTY_VALUE），直接模式（DIRECT）检测均线的转折（买入时谷底、卖出时峰顶），无信号模式（WITHOUT）则不产生信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可基于卖出信号点或均线下降，卖出平仓可基于买入信号点或均线上升。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode支持按自由保证金、余额、考虑浮亏的保证金或固定手数四种模式。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理，包含止损和止盈设置。EA在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时计算信号，避免每tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator, which combines a J2JMA dual-smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode checks for signal dots in indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values), DIRECT mode detects turning points in the J2JMA line (valley for buy, peak for sell), and WITHOUT mode disables signals entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes — buy positions can close on sell signal dots or a declining J2JMA line, while sell positions can close on buy signal dots or a rising J2JMA line. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter as a risk fraction, with MMMode offering four modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) which handle stop-loss and take-profit placement. The EA calculates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar is zero, avoiding redundant per-tick calculations for efficiency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式（自由保证金/余额/含浮亏保证金/含浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 支持多种入场和出场信号模式，灵活度高，适应不同市场环境
使用J2JMA双平滑滤波器减少假信号，标准差通道提供动态波动参考
新K线机制避免每tick重复计算，执行效率较高
提供四种保证金管理模式，资金管理灵活
止损止盈参数完整，风险控制基础框架齐全
pros_en: Supports multiple entry and exit signal modes (POINT, DIRECT, WITHOUT) providing high flexibility for different market conditions
J2JMA dual-smoothed filter reduces false signals while standard deviation bands offer dynamic volatility reference
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant per-tick calculations, improving execution efficiency
Four margin management modes provide flexible money management options
Complete stop-loss and take-profit parameters form a solid basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库和ColorJ2JMAStDev自定义指标，缺少这些文件EA无法编译运行
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，对多数品种可能不合适
缺乏对已有持仓的检查逻辑，可能重复开仓
指标参数（Length、Phase、dK）缺乏自适应机制，需手动优化
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library and ColorJ2JMAStDev custom indicator — without them the EA cannot compile or run
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are excessively large and likely unsuitable for most instruments without optimization
Lacks explicit position existence checks before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions
Indicator parameters (Length, Phase, dK) lack adaptive mechanisms and require manual optimization
improvements: 添加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，防止高点差滑点和重复开仓
增加参数自适应机制或动态止损止盈，根据ATR或波动率自动调整关键参数
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and maximum position checks to prevent high-spread slippage and duplicate position opening
Implement parameter adaptation or dynamic SL/TP based on ATR or volatility for automatic parameter adjustment

risk_points: 依赖外部库和自定义指标，缺失任何组件将导致EA初始化失败
无显式持仓检查，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
止损止盈默认值极大（1000/2000点），未优化的情况下风险敞口过高
risk_points_en: Dependency on external library and custom indicator — missing any component causes EA initialization failure
No explicit position existence check before opening trades, risking duplicate positions on the same signal
Default SL/TP values are extremely large (1000/2000 points), creating excessive risk exposure without optimization

It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes to size positions.
